title: Early Middle Stone Age personal ornaments from Bizmoune Cave, Essaouira, Morocco
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a reproduction of the source.

passages.note: Most perforations are partly natural with some modified; the overlying flowstone age is 102,980 ± 9,620 years (2σ). Layer 4c luminescence dates are markedly younger than uranium-series dates.
